description: Call GET /api/v1/google/trends/trending-now for Google SERP Trends Trending Now through Just Serp API with geo.

operations.description: Get Google trends Trending Now data, including latest trending topics, region and time-window filters, and volume indicators, for breaking-trend monitoring and editorial planning.

parameters.description: The geographic location code to retrieve real-time trends for (e.g., 'US' for United States). Default is 'US'.
parameters.name: geo

parameters.description: Time window for trending topics. Supported values: '4' (past 4 hours), '24' (past 24 hours), '48' (past 48 hours), '168' (past 7 days).
parameters.name: hours

parameters.description: Set the language for the results using its two-letter code (e.g., 'en').
parameters.name: language

responses.description: Authentication failed: API Key is invalid or missing
